verdict.rationale: Trilegal is a full-service Indian law firm, not a software or API platform, so a sandbox test environment isolated from production data is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships one: the DPDPA Compliance Assessment Tool is a legal self-assessment resource, not a sandbox, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
